what: ADVERSARIAL, RENDERER-FREE settlement of the two things the rolling-shutter stream left open: (a) which SIDE of the mp4/rig pair carries the extra frames, (b) whether the offset is a constant +6. No GPU was used; tanitad-thor was running two other streams' jobs at 98 % sm and 108/122 GB, so no render was launched.
instruments: stack/experiments/alpasim-gsplat/rs_align_gpufree.py  -- cross-correlates the mp4's frame-to-frame image motion against the rig's ego translation per frame
stack/experiments/alpasim-gsplat/rs_leader_probe.py   -- full-resolution head/tail frame differencing + the rig's own speed at those frames

third_independent_source.why: neither the mp4 nor rig_trajectories.json -- the dataset's own manifest
third_independent_source.reading: the DATASET says 599. The mp4 decodes to more. The extra frames belong to the mp4, not to the rig.

00040136-e651-4abd-991d-0655ccda9430.VERDICT: MEASURED. The mp4 opens with a 7-frame FROZEN block (full-res consecutive |dI| 0.013-0.38, versus 3.5-8.2 once motion starts) while the rig says the ego is doing 20.6 m/s at its very first frame. A moving camera cannot produce 7 identical frames. The extra 6 frames are a LEADER at the HEAD of the mp4: the pad is a repeat of the first real frame, pad = 6 = mp4 - rig, real frame k = mp4[k+6]. Independently, cross-correlating image motion against ego translation -- a signal that touches neither the renderer nor grad-NCC -- peaks at exactly +6 and turns over at +7. The stream's +6 is CONFIRMED and its open question 'WHICH SIDE IS WRONG' is ANSWERED: the mp4 leads, so the reference index must be RAISED by the pad.

7c72937c-c620-4776-9555-d57222c0081f.crosscorr_note: UNINFORMATIVE ON THIS SCENE. r rises monotonically from -15 to +15 with no turnover, because the ego is STATIONARY for the first 9 rig frames, so image motion carries no speed signal to correlate against. Reported as an instrument failure, not as a +15 offset.
7c72937c-c620-4776-9555-d57222c0081f.VERDICT: THE OFFSET IS NOT A CONSTANT +6. This scene's mp4 carries 5 extra frames, not 6, and its static head block is 5 frames -- consistent with 5 pad frames followed by 599 real frames (5 + 599 = 604). Hardcoding +6 would put this scene off by one.

CORRECTED_RULE.statement: video_frame_index = rig_frame_index + (n_mp4_decodable - n_rig_frames), read PER SCENE.
CORRECTED_RULE.evidence_class: MEASURED on 2 of 2 scenes that have both files on tanitad-thor (the only two present); the pad-equals-delta identity is verified directly on 00040136 and is arithmetically forced on 7c72937c by 5 + 599 = 604.
CORRECTED_RULE.not_established: that every NuRec scene has a leader at all, or that the pad is always a repeat of the first real frame. Only 2 scenes have the mp4 downloaded; the other 62 do not.

CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_STREAM: The +6 finding SURVIVES on 00040136 and is strengthened by two renderer-free probes and by the dataset manifest. The generalisation to a constant +6 is REFUTED at the second scene. Anyone actioning task #58 must read the per-scene delta, not add 6.
